title: Good-representative normalization predicate for an integral scalar comparison
statement: Fix a prime l, an algebraic closure Ω of Q_l and a noetherian finite-dimensional scheme T on which l is invertible. Fix stage identity comparisons I, ordinary transports o, and integral comparison isomorphisms b as in [def-fd-coefficient-comparison-datum, lem-fd-raw-localization-scalar-coherence]. Define fdIntegralScalarLiftProperty(o,b) to mean that for every coefficient inclusion and every good representative V with constructible derived image, the ambient b component, followed by the target integral_identity cast, scalar representative comparison, and coefficient-transport factor, is heterogeneously equal to ambient ordinary extension of the source transport factor followed by the actual completed-scalar counit and derived image of o.completion. The defining equation is exactly the representative-lift clause of lem-fd-integral-scalar-descent-inputs, copied verbatim in Lean. It is a proposition about the supplied maps; it constructs no maps and makes no existence claim.

source.place: Coefficient-category auxiliary for finite-dimensional algebraically closed coefficient stalks; agent-written integral comparison and localization arguments retained in lem-fd-completion-inverse-scalar-coherence, original steps 1–8.

from.place: Retained integral comparison step: naming its displayed good-representative lift equation to avoid elaborating the same long dependent proposition in every consumer.

lean.statement:
def fdIntegralScalarLiftProperty
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (Ω : Type w) [Field Ω] [Algebra ℚ_[l] Ω] [IsAlgClosure ℚ_[l] Ω]
    (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T]
    [dT : Fact (∃ n : ℕ, topologicalKrullDim T ≤ n)]
    [iT : Fact (∀ t : T, IsUnit (l : T.presheaf.stalk t))]
    (stage : ∀ E : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω, FdRationalStageComparison l Ω T E)
    (ordinary : ∀ {E L : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω} (h : E ≤ L),
      FdOrdinaryScalarTransport l Ω T h)
    (b : ∀ {E L : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω} (h : E ≤ L),
      I l Ω T stage E ⋙ C l Ω T h ≅ U l Ω T h ⋙ I l Ω T stage L)
 : Prop
